description: Playtest report 'Drought lasts more than 2 turns' was not an engine bug: each Drought lasts one round, but each deck holds its own Drought (reshuffled from discard), so two can land back to back or in the same round and stack; the UI showed one Drought as '3 effects' with no end. Simulate before changing rules code; log event ends.
resolution: Event panel groups modifiers per event card with a copy count; engine logs '<event> ends after round N'.
